description: Curated database of safe-to-remove bloatware, tracking daemons, adware engines, and hidden background installers across Android OEM skins.

ads_and_telemetry.name: MIUI System Ads (MSA Global)
ads_and_telemetry.description: Xiaomi's primary background ad-push service. Injects promoted banner ads into system apps and settings.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Eliminates system-wide banner ads and reduces background HTTP polling.

ads_and_telemetry.name: MIUI Analytics
ads_and_telemetry.description: Logs app launch frequencies, user screen time, and hardware telemetry back to Xiaomi data centers.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Stops background tracking wake-locks and reduces network bandwidth.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Xiaomi Joyose Game / Telemetry Daemon
ads_and_telemetry.description: Background service that manages OEM game throttling, SMS push telemetry, and sports data. NOTE: Removing this unlocks thermal headroom and raises benchmark/gaming FPS, but device may run warmer under heavy continuous load.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Unlocks sustained performance in games; disables Xiaomi ad telemetry hooks.

ads_and_telemetry.name: MIUI Bug Report & Feedback
ads_and_telemetry.description: Crash logging and feedback telemetry daemon that frequently uploads stack traces.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Saves battery by stopping background log uploads.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Miui Quick Apps (Hybrid)
ads_and_telemetry.description: HTML5 quick app launcher framework frequently abused to serve interstitial ads and bypass app store security.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Closes a major advertising and tracking vector.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Miui Quick Apps Accessory
ads_and_telemetry.description: Companion daemon for Miui Quick Apps ad runtime.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Prevents background startup of quick apps service.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Digital Turbine / Aura OOBE (Xiaomi)
ads_and_telemetry.description: Carrier and OEM bloatware distribution platform that silently downloads sponsored apps during setup and updates.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Completely prevents silent background sponsored app installations.

ads_and_telemetry.name: IronSource Aura Daemon
ads_and_telemetry.description: Third-party ad and app recommendation engine integrated into device setup.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Stops unwanted ad SDK activity and app recommendations.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Samsung Free / Bixby Home
ads_and_telemetry.description: -1 screen aggregator on One UI filled with sponsored articles, gaming ads, and video promotions.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Frees memory and removes clutter from home screen launcher.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Samsung Customization Service (Rubin)
ads_and_telemetry.description: Analyzes device usage patterns, location, and app history to serve personalized advertising.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Eliminates cross-app tracking on Samsung devices.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Google Meet (Duo Preinstall)
ads_and_telemetry.description: Pre-installed Google video calling app. Safe to remove if user uses WhatsApp, Telegram, or Zoom.
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Frees RAM and background sync cycles.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Facebook Client Preinstall
ads_and_telemetry.description: Factory preloaded Facebook app. Often holds background wake-locks.

ads_and_telemetry.name: Facebook Messenger Preinstall
ads_and_telemetry.impact: Frees RAM and background push connections.

hidden_installers.name: Facebook App Installer
hidden_installers.description: System-privileged installer allowing Meta apps to download and install updates silently outside the Google Play Store.
hidden_installers.impact: Prevents unauthorized background app updates and persistent Meta telemetry.

hidden_installers.name: Facebook App Manager
hidden_installers.description: Background service that manages Meta asset caches and sideloads partner apps.

hidden_installers.name: Facebook Services
hidden_installers.description: Framework layer connecting Android system events to Meta telemetry.
hidden_installers.impact: Stops background analytics transmission to Meta.

hidden_installers.name: Xiaomi GetApps Store
hidden_installers.description: Xiaomi's secondary proprietary app store. Continuously pushes promotional app install notifications and attempts silent APK downloads.
hidden_installers.impact: Eliminates spam notifications and background APK verification daemons.

hidden_installers.name: ColorOS App Market
hidden_installers.description: Oppo/Realme/OnePlus preinstalled app market with heavy promotional push notifications.
hidden_installers.impact: Stops spam alerts and background app update checks.

hidden_installers.name: Samsung Smart Switch Agent
hidden_installers.description: Background stub for Samsung Smart Switch device migration. Unneeded once phone is initially set up.

hidden_installers.name: Samsung OMC Agent
hidden_installers.description: Open Market Customization daemon that checks for carrier-specific bloatware profiles.

oem_bloat.name: Wallpaper Carousel (FashionGallery)
oem_bloat.description: Lockscreen wallpaper cycler that pulls sponsored ad content, clickbait news, and commercial images directly onto lockscreen.
oem_bloat.impact: Removes intrusive lockscreen ads and saves cellular data.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Browser Pro
oem_bloat.description: Xiaomi's proprietary Chromium fork with built-in trending feeds, sponsored shortcuts, and search telemetry.
oem_bloat.impact: Frees ~150MB of storage and removes privacy-invasive browsing hooks.

oem_bloat.name: Xiaomi Game Center
oem_bloat.description: Aggressive game store with pay-to-win recommendations and persistent promotional notification banners.

oem_bloat.name: Xiaomi Yellow Pages
oem_bloat.description: Caller ID service integrated with Chinese/Indian commercial databases. Intercepts incoming call queries to serve business directory ads.
oem_bloat.impact: Protects call privacy and eliminates dialer business ads.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Video
oem_bloat.description: Default media player heavily modified to push trending online video ads, adult dating banners, and continuous notifications.
oem_bloat.impact: Eliminates video ad spam; replace with VLC or Just Player.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Music
oem_bloat.description: Default audio player bundled with streaming store promotions and banner advertisements.
oem_bloat.impact: Frees RAM and removes audio ad prompts; replace with Musicolet or Retro Music.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Pay Framework
oem_bloat.description: Xiaomi's proprietary mobile payment framework (primarily used in China/India). Unnecessary if using Google Wallet.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Credit / Wallet India
oem_bloat.description: Instant loan and credit card advertisement utility bundled into Indian/Global ROMs.

oem_bloat.name: Clean Master Definition Engine
oem_bloat.description: Legacy Cheetah Mobile cleaning definitions embedded into MIUI cleaner.
oem_bloat.impact: Stops telemetry reporting to Cheetah Mobile servers.

oem_bloat.name: Mi Weather
oem_bloat.description: Default weather app containing sponsored news articles and animated ad cards.
oem_bloat.impact: Removes sponsored content in weather feeds.

oem_bloat.name: Xiaomi Notes
oem_bloat.description: Stock note taking app. Safe to remove if using Google Keep, Obsidian, or Notion.
oem_bloat.impact: Removes unused app and cloud sync overhead.

oem_bloat.name: Xiaomi Compass
oem_bloat.description: Stock compass app. Safe to remove if not needed.

oem_bloat.name: Xiaomi Calculator
oem_bloat.description: Stock calculator app with currency and mortgage conversion tools.
oem_bloat.impact: Safe to remove if using Google Calculator.

oem_bloat.name: Bixby Voice Agent
oem_bloat.description: Samsung voice assistant daemon running continuous microphone background listeners.
oem_bloat.impact: Saves battery and RAM; eliminates unwanted Bixby side-button launches.

oem_bloat.name: Samsung Gaming Hub
oem_bloat.description: Game launcher containing sponsored game recommendations and advertisements.

oem_bloat.name: ColorOS Lockscreen Magazine
oem_bloat.description: Oppo/Realme lock screen wallpaper cycler delivering sponsored content and news.
oem_bloat.impact: Stops lock screen ad delivery and saves background data.

ru_region_preloads.name: RuStore App Marketplace
ru_region_preloads.description: Russian mandated alternative application marketplace. Keeps persistent background update services running.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Frees background memory and stops app update prompts.

ru_region_preloads.name: Yandex Search & Assistant
ru_region_preloads.description: Mandated search app, widget and Alice voice assistant daemon.

ru_region_preloads.name: Yandex Browser
ru_region_preloads.description: Yandex Chromium-based web browser preinstalled on Russian firmware builds.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Frees ~250MB storage and background push services.

ru_region_preloads.name: Yandex Browser (Alternative ID)
ru_region_preloads.description: Alternative package ID for Yandex Browser preinstall.

ru_region_preloads.name: VKontakte (VK)
ru_region_preloads.description: Preloaded Russian social network client. Heavy background notification and cache footprint.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Frees ~300MB RAM and persistent background sockets.

ru_region_preloads.name: Mail.ru Email Client
ru_region_preloads.description: Preloaded email client from VK / Mail.ru group.

ru_region_preloads.name: MyOffice Documents
ru_region_preloads.description: Russian mandated office document viewer/editor preinstall stub.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Frees internal storage and removes unnecessary file association handlers.

ru_region_preloads.name: MyOffice Documents (OEM Stub)
ru_region_preloads.description: Alternative stub identifier for MyOffice preinstall.

ru_region_preloads.name: Rutube Video Platform
ru_region_preloads.description: Preloaded Russian video hosting client with notification promotions.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Frees storage and removes video streaming cache.

ru_region_preloads.name: Kaspersky Mobile Security
ru_region_preloads.description: Third-party antivirus scanner preloaded on retail devices. Highly intrusive background file monitoring.
ru_region_preloads.impact: Drastically reduces I/O load and background CPU cycles.

ru_region_preloads.name: Yandex Disk Cloud
ru_region_preloads.description: Cloud backup and photo sync utility.

ru_region_preloads.name: Gosuslugi Portal Stub
ru_region_preloads.description: Russian public services portal preinstall stub. Remove if unused or reinstall from Play/RuStore on demand.
